title: Desktop Agent
intent: Show Protopass Pro: a desktop app whose built-in agent prototypes a site or an app with Minimaly, checks every state and hands it over ready to build.
note: Mockup of the paid offer, also a template to start from. Screens are captured for the landing page.

states.name: Default
states.note: Empty composer, starter templates, recent projects

states.name: Typing
states.note: Idea written, brand guide attached, Send enabled

states.name: Working
states.note: Tool call running, preview updating, Stop replaces Send

states.name: Done
states.note: Checks passed, answer with sources, next steps

states.name: Error
states.note: Contrast check failed, two fixes offered

states.name: Command palette
states.note: ⌘K over the session, every command listed

states.name: Waiting for approval
states.note: Plan, changed files and diff, Apply or Reject

states.name: Applied
states.note: Plan done, checks pass, Undo in a toast

states.name: Mobile
states.note: Same screen in a 390 px frame

states.name: Default
states.note: Intent, screens and states, flows, Q&A, open question, checks

flows.name: Start a prototype
flows.statement: As a product designer, I should be able to turn a one-line idea into a clickable prototype.

flows.name: Review the agent's changes
flows.statement: As a product designer, I should be able to see and approve every change before the agent applies it.

flows.name: Hand off the prototype
flows.statement: As a product designer, I should be able to hand the prototype to a developer or an AI agent with everything needed to build it.

qa.q: Does the agent change files without asking?
qa.a: No. It shows the plan and the diff; nothing is written until Apply. Undo restores the previous version.

qa.q: What does the agent check after it writes screens?
qa.a: The design system validator and the render lint, every state in light and dark. A failed check stops the run and offers fixes.

qa.q: What does the shared link open?
qa.a: The handoff page: intent, screens and states, flows, Q&A and open questions. Viewers can play the prototype but not edit it.
On every screen of the app. The mockup shows it over the session only.

questions: Keep the "Copy to Figma" label? It is the only third-party name in the mockup.

Minimaly gap: dark --color-text-tertiary reads 3.04:1 on raised surfaces, so nav sections and counts, tool-call targets, card tags, pending steps, stepper status, list trails, palette labels and sticky-header subtitles fail the contrast lint in dark. Needs a lighter dark tertiary or an explicit acceptContrast decision.
Minimaly gap: a running tool-call name (agent violet) reads 4.29:1 on the dark raised surface.

Minimaly gap: segmented options are 26 px inside a 32 px group, cite is 16 px by design, toast buttons are 28 px, and dialog__body overlaps dialog__head by 4 px: the render lint flags all four. Needs lint exceptions or component changes.
Minimaly gap: streamText writes plain text, so an answer with cite links cannot stream. Needs an HTML-aware mode that streams words and inserts inline elements whole.
Minimaly gap: no diff component. Review builds it locally (.diff: file head, hunk line, numbered added and removed lines); any agent product needs one.
Minimaly gap: no chat message layout (the person's message, the agent's turn with its name) and no card footer for actions; both are local (.ask, .turn, .who, .permit__foot).
Minimaly gap: shell has no right pane; the conversation and preview split is local (.workspace, .pane).
Kit gap: validate.mjs cannot see components built at run time (toast(), data-tip tooltips), so listing them raises M204.

Kit gap: lint.html measures 50 ms after switching the theme; in a background page CSS transitions do not advance and colors read as light values. Finishing document animations before measuring fixes it.
